title: pi-push-prompts configuration
description: Selection, optional metadata, model bindings and the presentation setting for the pi-push-prompts extension. Stored at <agentDir>/push-prompts/config.json or <projectDir>/.pi/push-prompts/config.json. Profile text lives in profiles/<id>/prepend.md and profiles/<id>/append.md beside it.

version.description: Schema version. A future version is rejected and the file is not applied.

selection.description: Baseline selection for a session, overridden by the selection stored in the session.

defaultProfile.description: Profile used in auto mode when no binding matches.

profiles.description: Optional metadata keyed by profile id.

extends.description: Single optional parent profile. A bare id resolves inside the same scope.

match.description: Rules are OR-ed; provider and model inside a rule are AND-ed.

provider.description: Exact value or a single * wildcard. Omitted means *.

model.description: Exact value or a single * wildcard. Omitted means *. A * crosses / in model ids.

inheritGlobalBindings.description: Project-only. false makes the project ignore global bindings.

subagents.description: How profiles apply inside a subagent run. 'bindings' (default) uses only an explicit binding that matches the child's model, 'inherit' resolves normally including defaultProfile, and 'off' adds nothing.

display.description: Presentation only. 'hidden' (default) draws nothing for a decorated message; 'added' draws a row with the text that was inserted. The stored message and the request are the same either way.

profileReference.description: A bare id, or an explicit global:id / project:id reference. Stored references are normalized to the explicit form.
